title: H5 Helicopters
specs: Aircraft used for IMAX, National Geographic, Netflix, AppleTV aerial filming
Pilots have over 55 years combined experience and perfect safety record
Sunset flights highly recommended and popular
Children under 2 may sit on a parent's lap; 2 and older must have own seat per FAA
No age restrictions; no maximum age limit
Passenger weight limit 850 lbs total, 300 lbs per passenger (sometimes reduced in summer)
Pregnant guests in third trimester should consult doctor before flying
Guests with disabilities or mobility limitations can be assisted; folding wheelchair storage possible
H5 Hangar Group Experience designed for groups up to about 60 guests
Private flights only; no shared tours

blurb: Guests fly private helicopter tours over Arizona's scenic landscapes including Phoenix, Sedona, and the Grand Canyon. Flights are narrated by expert pilots and include a climate-controlled cabin with Bose noise-cancelling headsets. Group experiences include a hangar venue with continuous helicopter rotations for up to about 60 guests.
extraNote: Rates billed per flight, not per person, up to 5 passengers · No taxes on flights; 3.65% processing fee for credit card payments · Weather delays or cancellations incur no charge; safety prioritized · Guests can cancel immediately after takeoff if uncomfortable, no questions asked · Private hangar at Scottsdale Airpark, adjacent to Scottsdale Airport · Nearly year-round
